BOARD OF ARCHITECTURAL REVIEW
March 30, 2022 Work Session Minutes

The Board of Architectural Review met for a work session for The Maple Room Wednesday March 30, 2022 at 10:00 AM in the Vienna Town Hall at 127 Center St S. Present in town hall were Chairman Roy Baldwin, Vice-Chair Michael Cheselka, Patty Hanley, Paul Layer, Linda van Doorn , Planning and Zoning Administrator Andera West, Planner Sharmaine Abaied, and Board Clerk Yaska Camacho Castillo. 

The applicants present were: Christo Sarantis- Owner of The Maple Room- 21441 Pacific Boulevard Sterling, VA, Keith Iott - Architect 310 Hammond St Salisbury, MD, John Gaston - Civil Engineer 21441 Pacific Boulevard Sterling, VA

Mr. Keith gave the Board a brief presentation regarding proposed exterior modifications to The Maple Room, the old Amphora restaurant. 

The Board discussed the proposed changes and recommended the following:

-	Instead of painting the board suggested to power wash the stones.
-	Tower to come down to 3ft rather than 5 ft. 
-	Instead of having the windows on the front the board suggested to have them on the side. 
-	Color scheme changes to natural or potentially a charcoal grey.
-	Sign panel to be located at the front.
-	Fountain to be part of the application process.
-	Exploring the hardy Panels vs EIFS
-	Board members to look at the stones after it has been power washed.
-	Second work session recommended 

The meeting was adjourned at 11:11 AM

Respectfully Submitted, 
Yaska Camacho Castillo 
Board Clerk
